decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program is a visibly presented, staff- and approval-intensive extension of the firm's core psychiatric care, so management will persist and attribute any weak uptake to the build-up phase.
The carpentry workshop has sunk equipment investment, its own page and a link to the firm's participation mission, so management will keep it even though the related retail shop was closed.
Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's announced outpatient direction and runs on existing expertise, so it stays, though its low visibility leaves some risk of withdrawal.

The meal delivery service launched only in 2024, so disappointing early results can still be put down to the start-up phase, but its low investment and visibility make it more exposed than the core psychiatric offers.
